source_policy: Longest shared complete-day segment chosen solely by previously audited quality; no repairs, imputation or source replacement.
cost_policy: Each side charges half nominal roundtrip bps on actual modeled notional, including fee plus assumed spread/slippage; reserve in fixed signal-close quantity.
touch_policy: Enumerate both stop-first and target-first full histories when same minute touches both. Fail closed above per-symbol64 or joint4096 histories.
entry_policy: Fixed signal-close quantity floored8decimals, next1m-open all-or-reject cash affordability; no resizing, borrowing, pyramiding or orders.
clock_policy: Process all old-bracket minutes before completed8h decision. Market exit at next1m-open precedes later range touches. Protection activates immediately after modeled entry. CMF checks ROI only at observed minute close; pending ROI executes next open; source exit at shared boundary takes reason priority. No intrabar re-entry.
endpoint_policy: Completed events use modeled exit reference; still-held events retain statusCENSORED_MTM and cutoff close mark with hypothetical liquidation burden, never a fictitious order or completed trade.
principal_return_estimand: All admitted entry-to-exit-or-fixed-cutoff net reference returns; completed-only means separately descriptive. Per-unit return=(exit/entry)*(1-sidecost)/(1+sidecost)-1.
funded_btc_benchmark: At each accepted alt entry allocate the same alt notional/preentry-cash fraction from a separate BTC cash account. Exact BTC open entry; open exit uses BTCopen, intraminute exit uses BTCminute low/high bounds; own costs and remaining inventory; cutoff uses known final close.
portfolio_policy: Equal three independent10000cash sleeves; mark held inventory at each8h close minus hypothetical sale burden. Enumerate all symbol-history combinations for metrics. BTC lower/upper wealth intervals remain conservative reference bounds, not executions.
bootstrap_policy: Moving contiguous4calendar-week blocks, including zero-event weeks; descriptive entry-week ratio-of-sums intervals; alpha0.05/2 per candidate, no global repeated-search inference.
placebo_policy: Randomize all raw entry flags within each entry-week preserving flag count, rerun same causal exit/bracket/sizing engine; recompute own ATR levels and durations, never preserve observed endogenous holding lengths. Compare maximum placebo cohort mean with minimum original history mean.
lag_policy: Shift raw entry flags7bars causally; same exit/risk engine; descriptive.
diagnostics: fixed UTC sessions and overlap memberships
funded BTC wealth and same-exit reference bounds
claim: Spent historical hypothetical development only; SCREEN_SURVIVOR permits separate future preregistration, never viable/untouched/positive-edge/deployment claim.
future_confirmation: User completion requires a separate immutable and adequately powered future-only protocol, calibrated costs/quotes/execution, controls and approval-bound paper reliability, frozen before observations start. No viable candidate until that confirmation passes.

psar.atr: TR0=high0-low0; TRt=max(high-low,abs(high-priorclose),abs(low-priorclose)); seed mean first14 at index13; thereafter priorATR+(TR-priorATR)/14
psar.sizing: 100% equity intent, fee-reserved signal-close quantity floor8; actual next-open all-or-reject
psar.recurrence: independent implementation of official Pine v5 documented recurrence; no native kernel parity claim
psar.bracket_update: each original qualifying long cross while held, including randomized/lag controls

cmf.roi_clock: completed 1m close, market liquidation at next available 1m open
cmf.roi_expression: round((minute_close*(1-fee))/(accepted_entry_open*(1+fee))-1,8) > .01; explicit port, no native bit parity claim
cmf.cutoff_roi: final completed minute trigger stays queued CENSORED_MTM with pending decision timestamp, no unavailable-open fill
cmf.stop_tick_rounding: none; continuous reference, not native tick rounding
cmf.order_adapter: hypothetical market entry/exit and conservative stop; source defaults are limit/off-exchange stop
cmf.missing_values: retain zero-range/zero-volume NaN; rolling21 min_periods21; no imputation
cmf.stake_adapter: 100% equity intent with fee reserve; source omits stake
cmf.same_clock_priority: known source exit before queued ROI exit; queued open exits before current range; stop touch before same minute close ROI

dependency_hash_policy: Python dependency bytes normalize CRLF to LF solely for cross-platform checkout; all data/audit fingerprints remain exact bytes
family_disclosure: PSAR reuses ATR payoff shape from prior Ichimoku; CMF shares broad volume family but different close-location signed flow. No independence/orthogonality claim. Native 5m CMF horizon adapted96x. SAR native shortcut rejected before outcomes on synthetic fixtures.
